svg.title: Flow figure: Complete the delivery, Is it a delivery job?, Refused, May this user complete it?, Already completed?, Rerun a failed job, Save in one transaction, Queue one delivery job, Mark the order delivered, Already posted?, Write the parcels out, Wait and try again, Job kept for a rerun, All records agree, Delivery jobs, Delivery job events, Sales orders, Parcel moves. Steps: Delivered, Not a delivery job, Ledger write fails, All tries fail, Repeat call.
svg.desc: The figure has these boxes: Complete the delivery, Is it a delivery job?, Refused, May this user complete it?, Already completed?, Rerun a failed job, Save in one transaction, Queue one delivery job, Mark the order delivered, Already posted?, Write the parcels out, Wait and try again, Job kept for a rerun, All records agree, Delivery jobs, Delivery job events, Sales orders, Parcel moves. Delivered. The driver taps complete. The API checks the job and the user. The API saves the job and a history row together. After the commit, the API queues one delivery job in Redis. The worker marks the order delivered. The same job then writes the parcels out. Not a delivery job. The job is not a delivery job. The API refuses. Ledger write fails. The API saves the completed job and queues the delivery job. The worker tries to write the parcels out. The write fails once. The job waits in the queue. The job runs again, and the parcels are written. The parcel ledger matches the delivery. All tries fail. The API saves the completed job and queues the delivery job. The worker tries to write the parcels out. Every try fails. After 5 tries, the job stops. Repeat call. The driver taps complete on a completed job. The API reruns the failed delivery job.

g.text: The driver taps complete. The API checks the job and the user.
The API saves the job and a history row together.
After the commit, the API queues one delivery job in Redis.
The worker marks the order delivered.
The same job then writes the parcels out.
The job is not a delivery job. The API refuses.
The API saves the completed job and queues the delivery job.
The worker tries to write the parcels out.
The write fails once. The job waits in the queue.
The job runs again, and the parcels are written.
The parcel ledger matches the delivery.
Every try fails. After 5 tries, the job stops.
The driver taps complete on a completed job.
The API reruns the failed delivery job.
